ex.s: In tonight’s Easter special they come to the aid of a family in need of some delicious inspiration on a budget.

ex.s: To think he is sleeping on the streets tonight    26    he could have stolen the money and paid for a place to stay in.

ex.s: They have a chat and the man starts to tell his story.“Twenty years ago tonight,” said the man, “I dined here at ‘Big Joe’ Brady’s with Jimmy Wells, my best chum, and the finest chap in the world.
ex.t: 他们聊天，男人开始讲述他的故事。“二十年前的今晚，”那人说， “我在‘大乔‘布雷迪餐厅和吉米·威尔斯一起吃饭，他是我最好的朋友，也是世界上最好的家伙。

ex.s: I came a thousand miles to stand in this door tonight, and it’s worth it if my old partner turns up.” (Excerpts from “After Twenty Years” by O.
ex.t: "我千里迢迢赶来，今晚站在这扇门前，如果我的老搭档出现，那就值了。"（摘自《二十年后》by O.）

ex.s: It struck me again tonight, as if I had not seen it almost daily for more than twenty years, – Why, here is Walden, the same woodland lake that I discovered so many years ago; ...
ex.t: 今晚我又再次大吃一惊,仿佛20多年来我几乎没有每天看到它,——为什么这里是瓦尔登,就是我很多年前发现的同一个林地湖;......
